official_sources: GOV.UK heat networks metering and billing 2026 update
official_measurement_examples: Energy Act 2023 provides powers for zoning but implementation regulations are still being drafted as of 26 July 2026
potential-zone pipeline is not a statutory designated zone
Ofgem market-framework regulation began on 27 January 2026 and is distinct from zoning designation
relevant heat networks must register by January 2027 under current Ofgem guidance
zoning opportunity area does not prove a connection obligation exists today
funding or technical-assistance eligibility is not zone designation
heat network regulation does not grant planning permission
zoning/regulation status does not establish parcel ownership or development yield
core_rules: potential zone is not designated zone
pipeline entry is not statutory designation
consultation outcome is not implementation SI
market regulation is distinct from zoning
Ofgem authorisation is not planning permission
registration deadline does not prove connection availability
zoning does not guarantee network construction
zoning does not guarantee connection capacity
funding support is not delivery proof
technical standard is not site compliance certificate
heat network policy does not calculate development yield
current and future regulatory dates must remain separate
no parcel heat-network clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
